shared_elements: zigzag or chevron-like repeated linear pattern
abstract schematic ornament covering the body of the object
justification: Both surfaces carry shallow incised, largely abstract linear ornament, and both include a small circle with a central dot among the motifs, which is the most specific overlap. Otherwise A depicts a monumental anthropomorphic figure with head, torso and belt-like bands plus discrete emblem-like devices, while B shows a dense allover field of repeated zigzag/serrated bands with schematic creature-like heads, with no figural body and no comparable layout.
